card: This PR replaces calls to EmplaceCoinInternalDANGER with AddCoin and SpendCoin across several coin cache unit test fixtures. It resolves the misuse of an internal AssumeUTXO snapshot-loading method for standard test fixture setup, keeping routine test coverage cleanly separated from snapshot loading internals. The change follows a review suggestion from PR #35295 and is extracted as an independent prerequisite for PR #36598.
evidence: Author description notes this decouples standard test fixtures and follows an earlier review suggestion on PR #35295 (discussion_r3421846300).
Author notes this is extracted from PR #36598 to allow independent review.
problem: Coin-cache test fixtures in coins_tests.cpp and coinsviewoverlay_tests.cpp use EmplaceCoinInternalDANGER to set up test state. Because that method is an internal bypass intended strictly for AssumeUTXO snapshot loading, using it in routine test fixtures unnecessarily couples standard cache tests to snapshot-specific mechanisms.

risk.why: Touches only unit test fixtures in coins_tests.cpp and coinsviewoverlay_tests.cpp; a bug would only cause false test failures.

scope_notes: Small test-only change (+10/-6 across two test files).
summary: Replaces usages of EmplaceCoinInternalDANGER with AddCoin and SpendCoin in unit test fixtures for the coin cache. It limits the use of EmplaceCoinInternalDANGER to dedicated fuzz, simulation, and duplicate-insertion tests that explicitly test snapshot coin insertion.
